theme: seasonality with a structural mechanism (mechanical flow, not a bare calendar date)
verdict: five of six mechanisms are noise; one (balanced-mandate month-end rebalancing) is marginal and forward-log only; nothing promoted

families.T: payroll-deferral turn-of-month contribution inflow, cap-weight tilt (6)
families.D: ETF distribution ex-date and coupon-DRIP plumbing (4)
families.L: tax-loss harvesting and the wash-sale clock (9)
families.X: single-name ex-dividend capture and DRIP pay-date (6, incl. 3 superseded buggy builds)
families.C: CONTROLS, excluded from the multiple-testing count and from every verdict (4)

cost_model.provenance: M0_AUCTION_FILLS.json tier A_rank_1_50 closing half-spread median 0.90 bp / mean 1.34 bp for the mega-cap tier; 3 bp/side for single equities is the kill bar this programme has used throughout

theme_wide_carryover.reading: the design-selected sign carries into held-out at a coin flip; the theme as a whole retains essentially nothing

sign_cost_correction: a large negative NET t on a weak GROSS series is cost drag, not a reversed edge: reversing a book flips gross but not cost, so the best achievable net is sign*gross - cost. Ranking on net first produced four false hits (T01, R01, R03, D04); all four have |gross t| < 1.5.

causes: inv3 stock panel carries RAW dividend-unadjusted prices, so the return realised ON an ex-date contains a mechanical drop equal to the dividend and any yield-correlated sort harvests a spurious spread
a position decided at close of t earns the t->t+1 return, so an offset of 1 session before the ex-date was in fact holding ACROSS the drop

best.name: P02_PENSION_MEQ_MAG
best.mechanism: a fixed-weight balanced mandate is obliged to sell whatever outperformed inside the period before the period boundary; the signal is minus the month-to-date equity-vs-bond divergence, held only over the last 4 sessions of the month

disposition: forward-log only at zero size; design and held-out are both spent, the only uncontaminated evidence left is forward
untested_declared: ETF creation/redemption seasonality (no share-count feed cached)
index add/delete reconstitution proper (no point-in-time membership data)

rows.name: L02_TLS_JAN_BOUNCE
rows.desc: post-harvest bounce: long the prior year's decile losers / short its winners through January

rows.name: P02_PENSION_MEQ_MAG
rows.desc: same as P01 but sized by the magnitude of the MTD divergence (a bigger drift obliges a bigger rebalance trade)

rows.name: D02_ETF_EXDIST_PRERUN
rows.desc: dividend-capture demand into a known ex-date: long the ETF vs SPY over ex-5..ex-2 (position closed before the drop), price return

rows.name: L03_TLS_WASHSALE_31D
rows.desc: the rule-dated repurchase: the wash-sale clock on mid-December selling expires 12-23 January. Long losers / short winners in exactly that window

rows.name: X01b_EXDIV_PRERUN_VS_PAYERS
rows.desc: capture demand ahead of a scheduled ex-date, hedged against OTHER DIVIDEND PAYERS so the value/low-beta style tilt cancels: long names 1-3 sessions before their ex-date, short the rest of the payer universe

rows.name: P05_PENSION_LASTDAY
rows.desc: the single session the rebalance actually prints: -sign(MTD SPY-IEF) held over the final session of the month only

rows.name: P01_PENSION_MEQ_SIGN
rows.desc: sell-the-outperformer 60/40 rebalance: -sign(MTD SPY-IEF), SPY vs IEF, held over the last 4 sessions of the month

rows.name: P07_PENSION_CREDIT
rows.desc: credit-sleeve rebalance: -sign(MTD HYG-IEF), last 4 sessions of the month

rows.name: L08_TLS_EMBEDDED_JAN
rows.desc: January bounce scored on embedded loss instead of YTD return

rows.name: W06_WD_CLOSE_TO_OPEN
rows.desc: the mechanical signature: a close-print mark-up must unwind in the next OPENING auction. Short the quarter's decile winners / long its losers from the quarter-end close to the next open

rows.name: T03_TOM_SIZE
rows.desc: the marginal contribution dollar is S&P-heavy: long SPY / short IWM over the TOM window

rows.name: X02_EXDIV_CAPTURE_UNWIND
rows.desc: the capture trade unwinds: short names 1-5 sessions AFTER their ex-date, long the universe

rows.name: W01_WD_QTR_MARKUP
rows.desc: window dressing into the reporting date: long top-decile QTD return / short bottom decile, held over the last 4 sessions of the quarter

rows.name: T01_TOM_CAPWEIGHT
rows.desc: cap-weight tilt of turn-of-month contribution flow: long SPY / short RSP (equal-weight sibling) over the -2..+2 session TOM window

rows.name: X02b_EXDIV_UNWIND_VS_PAYERS
rows.desc: the capture position unwinding: short names 1-5 sessions after their ex-date, long the rest of the payer universe

rows.name: R05_TSY_EXT_TLT_SHY
rows.desc: full-curve version of R01: long TLT / short SHY over the last 3 sessions of the month

rows.name: P06_PENSION_GLOBAL
rows.desc: regional-weight rebalance inside global balanced mandates: -sign(MTD SPY-EFA), last 4 sessions of the month

rows.name: W03_WD_MONTH_MARKUP
rows.desc: monthly-reporting version: long top-decile MTD / short bottom decile over the last 4 sessions of every month

rows.name: R04_CORP_INDEX_EXTENSION
rows.desc: same rulebook, credit sleeve: long LQD / short SHY over the last 3 sessions of the month

rows.name: W02_WD_QTR_GIVEBACK
rows.desc: the mark-up has no information: short the same top-decile QTD winners / long the losers over the first 3 sessions of the new quarter

rows.name: R02_TSY_EXT_UNWIND
rows.desc: the extension's give-back: short TLT / long IEF over the first 2 sessions of the new month

rows.name: L04_TLS_JAN_FIRSTWEEK
rows.desc: the naive-January control against L03: same book held only 2-8 January, before any wash-sale clock can have expired

rows.name: W05_WD_LASTSESSION
rows.desc: leaning for the tape: long top-decile QTD / short bottom decile held over the final session of the quarter only

rows.name: P03_PENSION_QTR
rows.desc: quarter-end version: -sign(QTD SPY-IEF) over the last 4 sessions of the quarter, when quarterly-mandate rebalancers join the monthly ones

rows.name: X03b_DRIP_PAYDATE_VS_PAYERS
rows.desc: DRIP reinvestment prints on the PAY date: long names on pay..pay+2 versus the rest of the payer universe (pay dates exist in the feed only from 2020, so the design window carries ~2 years of it)

rows.name: X03_DRIP_PAYDATE
rows.desc: DRIP reinvestment prints on the PAY date: long names on pay..pay+2, short the universe (pay dates only exist in this feed from 2020, so this book is almost entirely out of the design window and is reported as underpowered)

rows.name: W04_WD_MONTH_GIVEBACK
rows.desc: monthly give-back: short the month's decile winners / long its losers over the first 3 sessions of the new month

rows.name: P04_PENSION_UNWIND
rows.desc: the price-impact give-back: +sign(prior-month SPY-IEF divergence) held over the first 3 sessions of the new month

rows.name: L05_TLS_OCT_FUNDYEAR
rows.desc: US mutual funds close their tax year on 31 October: short the decile losers / long the winners through October

rows.name: D04_BONDETF_COUPON_DRIP
rows.desc: monthly-pay bond ETFs go ex on the first business day and PAY around the 7th; reinvested coupon buys the fund back. Long the monthly-pay basket vs SHY on sessions 4-8 of the month

rows.name: D01_ETF_EXDIST_RECOVERY
rows.desc: DRIP reinvestment lands a few sessions after the ETF's ex-distribution date: long the ex-ing ETF vs SPY from the ex close to ex+5, price return

rows.name: L07_TLS_EMBEDDED_LOSS
rows.desc: score the AMOUNT of unrealised loss, not the YTD return: depth below the trailing 250-session mean log price, short the deepest through 1-24 December

rows.name: T06_TOM_SETTLE12
rows.desc: settlement timing: the cap tilt only on the two sessions the T+1/T+2 money actually buys (first and second session of the new month)

rows.name: T02_TOM_MEGACAP
rows.desc: sharper cap tilt: long OEF (S&P100) / short SPY over the TOM window

rows.name: R03_TSY_EXT_REFUNDING
rows.desc: the extension is larger in quarterly-refunding settlement months: R01 sized 1.0 in Feb/May/Aug/Nov and 0.4 elsewhere

rows.name: R01_TSY_INDEX_EXTENSION
rows.desc: month-end index duration extension: long TLT / short IEF over the last 3 sessions of the month

rows.name: W07_WD_MONTHEND_CLOSE_TO_OPEN
rows.desc: same overnight signature at every month end

rows.name: C02_CTRL_R20REV_EVERYDAY
rows.desc: CONTROL: 20-session reversal decile book, every session -- the alive mechanism the seasonal books risk merely re-expressing

rows.name: X01_EXDIV_CAPTURE_PRERUN
rows.desc: dividend-capture demand ahead of a scheduled ex-date: long names whose ex date is 1-3 sessions away, short the eligible universe (position closed before the ex drop)

rows.name: D03_ETF_EXDIST_CROSS
rows.desc: hold across the ex-date and collect: total return over ex-1 -> ex, long the ETF vs SPY

rows.name: C01_CTRL_MTDMOM_EVERYDAY
rows.desc: CONTROL, not a candidate: the same MTD-decile long-short book held on EVERY session. If W03's number is not clearly bigger than this, the month-end window bought nothing

rows.name: L09_TLS_RETAIL_COHORT
rows.desc: harvesting is a TAXABLE-holder flow: L01 restricted to the retail-heavy sub-$15 price cohort

rows.name: L01_TLS_DEC_PRESSURE
rows.desc: harvesting pressure: short the bottom-decile YTD losers / long the top decile through 1-24 December

rows.name: L06_TLS_NOV_BOUNCE
rows.desc: the fund-year bounce: long October's decile losers / short its winners over 1-10 November

rows.name: C03_CTRL_YTDMOM_MIDYEAR
rows.desc: CONTROL: the L-family book (YTD-return deciles) held through JUNE, a month with no tax deadline attached to it

rows.name: T05_TOM_EQBOND
rows.desc: contribution money is ~70/30 equity-tilted: long SPY / short IEF over the TOM window

rows.name: T04_MIDMONTH_CAPWEIGHT
rows.desc: the SECOND payroll date: same SPY-vs-RSP cap tilt around the first session on/after the 15th (-2..+2). If the mechanism is payroll, this must fire too

rows.name: C04_CTRL_QTDMOM_MIDQTR
rows.desc: CONTROL: the W-family book (QTD deciles) held over the MIDDLE 4 sessions of each quarter instead of the last 4
